_: WS-E1 measurement dossier for Eighth College, built 2026-08-06. Every entry keyed by mass hash m:<cx>,<cz> = Math.round(vertex-average centroid) of the docs/data/campus-arcgis.json massing ring at build-campus-truecolor.mjs's keyOf() rule (rings /10) — verified against the actual massing polygons, which in one case (Sankofa Base) round 1m differently than the hand-given task centroid, so these keys are the polygon-derived ones, not the hand-rounded ones. Colours sampled with scripts/tmp-sample.mjs (median of a masked pixel patch) from Apple Maps 3D captures ONLY (.cache/apple-flyover, .cache/eighth-area) per the epoch rule — never from .cache/tiles-orbit, which is Google mid-construction imagery used only to cross-check facade geometry. Storey counts are GIS docs/data/campus-arcgis.json massing.levels, visually corroborated by counting window rows in a lit frame; bay_m is a VISUAL-ESTIMATE class measurement (piers counted in a near-corner, least-foreshortened crop, scaled by a floor-height calibration derived from the same crop) — treat it as a candidate figure, not survey-grade. Buildings with no captured station within useful range (Survivance tower+low sit toward the uncaptured r3 row) or with a facade never legibly resolved (Podemos low, unnamed dining pavilion, most of Sankofa Base) are OMITTED or marked resolved:false rather than guessed — see the builder report for the full per-mass account.

m:-68,594.name: Sankofa Tower
m:-68,594.note: bay_m derived from a floor-height calibration (64m/21 levels) applied to a near-corner pier count in sankofa-orbit-00-south.png — moderate confidence (±~25%), not a direct scale-bar measurement. Wall hex is a median of 4 panel samples ranging #a8a7ae–#efecf0 (mixed sun/shade); reported value is the mid sample.

m:-56,528.name: Podemos
m:-56,528.note: Identity confirmed by station proximity (Podemos centroid is 7.8m from the r1c3 capture target, next-nearest Eighth mass is 70m+ away). The dark reflective-glass face seen in r1c3-oblique-01-west is this same tower's short-end core, not a separate building.

m:-116,613.name: Sankofa Mid
m:-116,613.note: Wall samples in the top-down r2c2-plan-00-south.png frame were blown out by direct sun (l>0.95); walls value is from the same building's less-glared oblique frame instead.

m:-182,614.name: Azad
m:-182,614.note: Measured walls (#d8d3d3, light neutral grey-white) disagree with the unsourced first-guess #d2b895 (tan/khaki) — trust the measured value; Azad's centroid is only 13.7m from the r2c1 capture target, the closest station-to-mass match of any building in this dossier.

m:-154,556.name: Pulse Tower
m:-154,556.note: Pulse Tower and Pulse Mid are visually one continuous block in every available frame (both within ~40m of the r1c1 target, no station separates them) — this entry and m:-186,562 share the same measured walls/style/bay_m from the same facade. Levels (10 vs 9) come from GIS, not a visual per-mass split.

m:-186,562.name: Pulse Mid
m:-186,562.note: See Pulse Tower (m:-154,556) — same source facade, could not visually separate the two masses at this station; GIS levels kept distinct.

m:-97,609.name: Sankofa Base
m:-97,609.note: Only a dusty maroon canopy/soffit strip at the tower's ground-floor plinth was legible (measured #8c6d75, sampled twice, consistent) — recorded as an accent. The plinth's actual wall material (mostly glass storefront) sits in hard shadow in every captured frame at this station (r2c2, 20m away) and in r2c1/r2c3 (49-86m away); did not guess a walls value.
